set.body: Maintain coordinator-owned execution state updated after every reduced task. Record planned/started/completed/failed/retried counts, features and bytes, actual tiles, stage timings, source modes, memory evidence, runtime/package/platform identities, reporter failures, checkpoint state, and cleanup outcomes. Separate requested from observed BLAS threads and report unknown rather than hard-coding one. Check close, detach, and unlink results so cleanup failures cannot be reported as success.
set.title: Make execution receipts observational and cleanup truthful
